name: FuctionChat-Bench-ToolHub
description: A benchmark that evaluates chat models' ability to select and invoke external tools (APIs, functions) correctly and to integrate tool outputs into responses. It contains scenarios requiring correct tool selection, well-formed function calls, and interpretation of returned results. Intended to measure function-calling / tool-augmented agent behavior and task completion.
reputation: A community dataset with growing interest for evaluating function-calling and tool-enabled chat agents, but not yet a widely standardized benchmark.
